cases.exposure_context_quote: Eight hours prior to the presentation, she accidentally ingested the insecticide while manipulating a spraying device and developed intractable vomiting 20 minutes later.
cases.agent_quote: the family brought the bottle of the insecticide, which revealed that the compound ingested was lambda-cyhalothrin, an uncommon insecticide
cases.route: oral ingestion (accidental while manipulating a spraying device)
cases.circumstance: accidental ingestion while manipulating a spraying device

symptoms.quote: she accidentally ingested the insecticide while manipulating a spraying device and developed intractable vomiting 20 minutes later.
the patient was unconscious with a Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score of 4/15, BP of 78/42 mmHg, PR of 85 bpm, and SaO2 of 92% on high-flow oxygen.
her vitals in the next two hours were as follows: BP of 100/60 mmHg, PR of 110 bpm, and SaO2 of 88% (on room air).

symptoms.finding: irritability and altered mental sensorium, progressing to unconsciousness (GCS 4/15)
symptoms.quote: the patient became irritable and had an altered mental sensorium.
BP of 100/60 mmHg, PR of 110 bpm, and SaO2 of 88% (on room air).

cases.time_to_care: rushed to a local healthcare center after informing family, then referred; presented at index center eight hours after ingestion

labs.name: baseline investigations
labs.value: UNVERIFIED (ordered but values in Tables 1, 2 not present in text)
labs.quote: All baseline investigations were ordered, and she was kept sedated and on mechanical ventilation for the next two days with continuous monitoring.

treatment.name: gastric lavage (local center)
treatment.quote: Gastric lavage was performed, and she was administered the standard treatment for organophosphate poisoning

treatment.name: empiric OP-poisoning treatment: IV fluids, pralidoxime 1 g IV eight-hourly, atropine 20 mg IV stat then 10 mg in 100 mL NS over two hours (local center)
treatment.quote: intravenous (IV) fluids, injection pralidoxime (PAM) 1 g IV eight hourly, and injection atropine 20 mg IV stat, followed by 10 mg in 100 mL normal saline (NS) over the next two hours.

treatment.name: endotracheal intubation and mechanical ventilation
treatment.quote: Considering her low GCS score, endotracheal intubation was performed, and mechanical ventilation was commenced.

treatment.name: noradrenaline 2 mg in 500 mL NS at 30 mL/hour
treatment.quote: The patient was then commenced on noradrenaline 2 mg in 500 mL NS at 30 mL/hour.

treatment.name: hydrocortisone 100 mg BD and pheniramine 2 mL IV stat
treatment.quote: Injection hydrocortisone 100 mg BD and injection pheniramine 2 mL IV stat were also administered.

treatment.name: sedation and supportive care with continuous monitoring
treatment.quote: she was kept sedated and on mechanical ventilation for the next two days with continuous monitoring.

treatment.name: oral proton pump inhibitors at discharge
treatment.quote: She was monitored for two more days and discharged on oral proton pump inhibitors.

cases.outcome: recovered; extubated day three, discharged; follow-up uneventful
cases.outcome_quote: The patient was successfully extubated on day three and placed on a high-flow mask... She was monitored for two more days and discharged on oral proton pump inhibitors. Follow-up has been uneventful.
cases.notes: Initially mismanaged empirically as organophosphate poisoning; ventilated for two days; moved to medical ward.
